verdict.rationale: Meltano's marketing page claims 'Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts' but no documentation details how alerts integrate with Slack, email, or webhooks, nor is there evidence of row-count-level metrics per sync or a structured log/run-status UI. missing for 10: specifics on Slack/email/webhook alert configuration, run status dashboard details, row-count reporting per sync, and independent corroboration of alerting working in practice.
